name: AssistantMessage
description: A bounded message in an owner-scoped in-app assistant conversation

document_id.description: Optional owner-scoped AssistantDocument id used for this message

image_attachments.description: Optional bounded HTTPS image attachment URLs on owner user messages

references.description: Grounded page, section, or line references, when available

citation_text.description: Bounded display text for grounded references

answer_mode.description: Answer source: general, app_help, public_web, or document

web_sources.description: Validated bounded public sources used for a public web answer; contains no provider payload or private data

sent_at.description: ISO timestamp when the message was saved
